title: Graphic Design instructor - Project Based
description:
iSchool is an innovative and rapidly growing e-learning company that provides online coding and artificial intelligence education to students aged 6 to 18 years old. As a leading platform in the industry, we are committed to equipping the next generation with the skills they need to thrive in the digital era. We are currently seeking a dynamic and passionate individual to join our team as a Coding Instructor for a project-based position lasting 3 months.
Overview
We are seeking a Digital Arts Track Instructor responsible for delivering engaging, hands-on sessions that introduce students to the fundamentals of digital design, animation, video editing, and 3D content creation. The instructor will guide students through practical creative workflows using industry-relevant tools such as Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity.

The role focuses on helping students understand core visual design principles, animation fundamentals, and digital media production while encouraging creativity, problem-solving, and project-based learning.
Key Responsibilities

• Deliver structured sessions covering digital design, animation, video editing, and 3D modeling fundamentals.

• Teach students how to use digital creative tools including Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity.

• Guide students through hands-on projects such as designing logos, creating vector illustrations, producing short videos, and building simple 3D models.

• Introduce design principles including shape composition, layout, and visual storytelling.

• Teach students how to break complex drawings into simple geometric shapes and design creative visual assets.

• Explain core 2D animation concepts including animation basics, character joints, and shape-based animation techniques.

• Demonstrate how animation is used in games, cartoons, and digital media.

• Teach the fundamentals of video editing including trimming clips, arranging timelines, adding text overlays, and adjusting basic audio.

• Introduce students to 3D modeling concepts using Blender, including navigating the interface and creating simple low‑poly models.

• Explain the differences between Eevee and Cycles render engines and guide students in exporting visual outputs.

• Guide students in importing assets into Unity and organizing them for basic game development workflows.

• Mentor students during exercises and projects while encouraging creativity and experimentation.

Requirements

• Strong understanding of digital design fundamentals , including composition, layout, and visual storytelling.

• Practical experience with digital creative tools , such as Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity .

• Knowledge of vector illustration and digital design workflows .

• Understanding of 2D animation fundamentals , including shape-based animation and character joints.

• Basic knowledge of video editing , including timeline management, trimming clips, adding text overlays, and basic audio adjustments.

• Familiarity with 3D modeling concepts in Blender , including creating simple low-poly models.

• Basic understanding of render engines (Eevee and Cycles) and exporting visual outputs.

• Basic knowledge of game development workflows , including importing and organizing assets in Unity.

• Ability to explain complex creative concepts in a simple and engaging way .

• Experience in guiding students through practical, project-based learning activities .

• Strong communication, mentoring, and classroom engagement skills .

Benefits

• Compatible Salary.

• Flexible Hours.

• Certificate of Experience

• Team Collaboration & Mentorship

title: Senior Manager, Sales Operations
description:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

- Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

- Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

- Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the Role

We're looking for an analytically sharp, operationally obsessed Senior Manager of Sales Operations to steward the tools and systems that power our sales teams. In this role, you'll become the resident expert on our sales motion and rep experience - diagnosing friction, surfacing improvement opportunities, and driving the changes that make our teams faster and more effective.

Reporting to the Director of Sales Operations, you'll serve as the primary business steward for Salesforce and our broader sales tech stack. You'll aggregate and prioritize enhancement requests, partner closely with our Product working team to execute them, and validate their impact before scaling. Critically, you won't just make changes - you'll oversee adoption, working with our change management teams to ensure reps are equipped to use new tools and workflows, and tracking whether changes actually land.

This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role for someone who thrives at the intersection of sales strategy, systems execution, and change management - and who can tell a compelling story to leadership about what the data says and what to do about it.

What You'll Do

Sales Motion & Rep Experience

- Develop a deep understanding of our end-to-end sales motion, workflows, and rep experience across all sales segments - through direct shadowing, structured interviews, and usage data

- Proactively identify pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement in our tools and processes

- Translate frontline rep feedback and usage patterns into actionable, prioritized enhancement recommendations

- Serve as the internal voice of the rep when making tooling and process decisions - ensuring changes improve day-to-day experience, not just system architecture

CRM & Tech Stack Strategy

- Serve as the primary business steward for Salesforce, owning the backlog of changes, enhancements, and new feature requests - including data quality, workflow automation, and reporting standards

- Aggregate, triage, and prioritize incoming requests from sales leadership, reps, and cross-functional partners; evaluate trade-offs and maintain a clear, well-reasoned improvement roadmap

- Oversee Salesforce data integrity and process consistency to ensure reporting is credible and adoption is measurable

- Evaluate, recommend, and support implementation of adjacent tools in the stack (e.g., Clay, LeanData, ZoomInfo, etc.)

- Assess opportunities to embed AI and automation into sales workflows - helping reps spend less time on manual tasks and more time on productive outreach

Testing, Validation & Adoption

- Design and support testing protocols to validate the impact of changes before broader rollout

- Define success metrics - including post-launch adoption rates, usage trends, and rep productivity impact - and monitor them consistently

- Drive adoption of new tools and workflows through documentation, training, and structured change management; don't declare a launch complete until adoption is real

- Synthesize learnings to inform future prioritization and build a continuous improvement loop

Reporting & Executive Communication

- Build and maintain reporting and dashboards that give Sales leadership visibility into tooling adoption, backlog health, and shipped improvements

- Translate complex operational data

title: Staff Software Engineer - Data Governance
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Washington D.C., London and Amsterdam.

The Data Governance team makes sure Plaid handles consumer and customer data responsibly - and can prove it. Our mission is to enforce Plaid's privacy commitments and regulatory obligations in the systems themselves rather than in policy documents: we build the platform and controls that govern how data flows through Plaid - where it lives, who can use it, for what purpose, and for how long. That includes verifiable deletion of consumer data on request, enforcement of data-use restrictions so downstream systems can only use data in permitted ways, and the cataloging and classification that let Plaid know what data it holds and how sensitive it is. We operate at the scale of Plaid's entire data footprint, and correctness and auditability matter to us as much as throughput.

As a Staff Software Engineer on Data Governance, you will set the technical direction for how Plaid enforces data governance at scale. You'll lead the design of distributed backend systems that reliably delete, restrict, and track data across dozens of services, making architectural decisions whose blast radius spans the whole company. You'll drive multi-quarter initiatives from ambiguous privacy and regulatory requirements through to shipped, auditable infrastructure - decomposing the hard problems, aligning multiple engineering teams behind a plan, and staying hands-on in the code for the highest-risk pieces. You'll be a force multiplier: raising the technical bar through design reviews and mentorship, and partnering deeply with Legal, Privacy, Security, and product-engineering teams to turn obligations into controls the rest of the company can build on.

Responsibilities

- Own the technical architecture for Plaid's data-governance platform

- Lead the design and delivery of multi-quarter, cross-team initiatives.

- Drive design reviews and set engineering standards for reliability, correctness, and auditability across the team's systems.

- Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, and product-engineering teams to shape requirements and unblock adoption of governance controls company-wide.

- Mentor engineers and level up the team's technical judgment; act as a technical point of contact for governance concerns raised by other teams.

Qualifications

Must-haves:

- Extensive experience (typically 8+ years) building and operating backend distributed systems at scale, in a language like Go, Java, or similar.

- A track record of leading the design of complex systems and driving cross-team technical initiatives to completion.

- Strong fundamentals in data stores, consistency, and reliability, with the judgment to reason about correctness and failure modes.

- Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans and align multiple stakeholders behind them.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including working effectively with non-engineering partners (legal, privacy, compliance).

Nice-to-have:

- Prior experience with data privacy, governance, or compliance systems (e.g., GDPR/CCPA deletion, data-use/consent enforcement, cataloging/classification, or auditing).

 
 

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission

description:
Vera Therapeutics is a biotechnology company focused on developing treatments for serious immunological diseases. Vera Therapeutics’ mission is to advance treatments that target the source of disease in order to change the standard of care for patients. Vera Therapeutics’ lead product candidate is atacicept, a fusion protein self-administered at home as a subcutaneous once weekly injection that blocks both B-cell Activating Factor (BAFF) and A Proliferation-Inducing Ligand (APRIL), which stimulate B cells to produce autoantibodies contributing to certain autoimmune diseases, including IgA nephropathy (IgAN) and lupus nephritis. Beyond IgAN, Vera Therapeutics is evaluating additional diseases where the reduction of autoantibodies by atacicept may prove clinically meaningful. In addition, Vera Therapeutics holds an exclusive license agreement with Stanford University for a novel, next generation fusion protein targeting BAFF and APRIL, known as VT-109, with wide therapeutic potential across the spectrum of B-cell-mediated diseases. Vera Therapeutics is also evaluating the development of MAU868, a monoclonal antibody designed to neutralize infection with BK virus, which can have devastating consequences in kidney transplant recipients. Vera Therapeutics retains all global developmental and commercial rights to atacicept, VT-109, and MAU868. For more information, please visit .

title: Senior Software Engineer — Matching
description:
Backstory helps companies understand the state of their revenue business by answering questions that span customer interactions, sales activity, pipeline health, and deal execution. The platform operates over trillions of sales activities, millions of deals, and more than 160 million business contacts, giving customers a unified view of the signals that drive revenue. Companies such as Nvidia, OpenAI, AMD, Red Hat, and Databricks rely on Backstory to surface risks, identify opportunities, and understand what's happening across their business.
Backstory is building AI systems that reason over massive amounts of enterprise data to help business leaders understand what's happening in their business and what to do next. We work at the intersection of large language models, retrieval, evaluation, distributed data systems, and product design, turning billions of signals from across the enterprise into insights people can trust. The underlying challenges span reasoning, search, ranking, data quality, knowledge representation, and operating AI systems against continuously evolving real-world information.
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Matching team, you will work on Backstory's foundational technology - matching business activities to business context. You will handle a vast amount of business data, perform data-driven research, design and develop algorithms and microservice architecture, write machine learning and automation code, and build scalable systems that power the AI-engine behind Backstory's products.
We value ownership highly - the ability to take an idea through all the stages from conception to shipping a product. This reflects throughout our company, but is especially true in engineering. As an engineer at Backstory, you'll be a part of a highly independent and autonomous team. Since we're building out a robust data layer that needs to be presented elegantly to the end-user, you'll be working with a large array of different technologies and fields. Expect lots of interesting challenges.
Responsibilities:

• Design and implement core backend services and data pipelines.

• Perform data-driven research using big data and leveraging Data Science toolset

• Document design choices and operational knowledge to successfully deploy and run services.

• Provide appropriate test coverage, unit and integration testing, with focus on performance and cost efficiency for your feature ownership areas.

• Ensure robust alerting, dashboards, and runbooks for production services are in place.

• Collaborate within the team and with other engineering teams to build new features and products according to business needs.

• Follow software design and development best practices and promote such practices in the team.

Requirements:

• 5+ years of professional experience working on backend systems in an enterprise environment

• 3+ years experience with data analysis / data science tasks and/or ML

• 2+ years experience programming in Python 2.x/3.x or Scala or Java

• Experience with AI development tools (especially agentic AI) is a plus

• Experience developing systems based on LLM is a plus

• Understanding of SOA, microservices, and event-driven architecture

• Experience with an enterprise-grade stack for scalable web apps including messaging broker, in-memory storages, NoSQL, and key-value databases

• Strong knowledge of TDD, Unit, and automated test paradigms

• Experience with SQL and RDBMS solutions

• Experience with large-scale data processing (Spark)

Headquartered in San Francisco, CA, Backstory is backed by Y Combinator and Silicon Valley’s top investors, including ICONIQ Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Akkadian Ventures, and Mubadala Capital. Backstory is listed in the top 20 percent of Inc 5000 companies, is a regular leader in our key categories on G2, and is on the Forbes list of America’s Best Startup Employers. For more information, please visit .

As a Senior AI Application Security Engineer, you will be a senior individual contributor at the center of that program.
You will own the code and pull-request enforcement layer that every change flows through, whether authored by a human or an AI coding agent. • Partner with harness engineering on agent scope declarations, agent identity registration, and the verification hooks that distinguish agent-initiated actions from human-initiated ones in the audit stream.

title: Compliance Officer
description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.
We operate across 3 business segments:
Corporate Secretary : Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and Sleek Sign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations
Accounting & Bookkeeping : Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary Sleek Books ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service
FinTech payments : Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses
Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.
Requirements
Mission of the role
To champion a culture of compliance and risk awareness across Sleek , ensuring adherence to regulatory standards globally while driving continuous improvement in our technology and processes.
Key outcomes in the first 6-12 months
Outcome 1: Know Your Customer (KYC)

• Review individual KYC exceptions and complete identification/verification within agreed SLAs.

• Complete corporate shareholder KYC reviews accurately and within agreed SLAs.

• Ensure all KYC decisions and supporting documentation are complete and appropriately recorded.

Outcome 2: Client Risk Assessment

• Independently approve low- and medium-risk client cases within SLA.

• Assess higher-risk cases and provide clear recommendations to the Head of Compliance within SLA.

• Apply sound judgement and a consistent, risk-based approach when assessing client risk.

Outcome 3: Screening & Monitoring Alerts

• Review name screening alerts within SLA and accurately determine whether they are false positives or potential true hits requiring escalation.

• Review transaction monitoring alerts within SLA and determine whether they can be closed or require further investigation.

• Ensure decisions are appropriately documented and escalated where required.

Outcome 4: Process & Technology Improvement

• Review existing Compliance policies, tools and processes and identify opportunities for improvement.

• Work with the Head of Compliance to improve the efficiency, consistency and effectiveness of compliance operations.

• Identify opportunities to leverage technology and AI to improve compliance workflows and decision-making.

Must-have experience

• Bachelor's degree.

• Experience in a role involving analysis, judgement and/or risk assessment ; previous Compliance experience is not strictly required.

• Experience using AI tools in the workplace , ideally including experimentation with or practical exposure to agentic AI .

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess information, identify risks and make sound decisions.

• Ability to work with data and technology and learn new systems quickly.

Must-have attributes

•
Structured thinking & sound judgement - able to assess complex information, identify risks and make well-reasoned decisions.

•
Excellent communication - strong written and spoken English, with the ability to clearly explain decisions and recommendations.

•
Curiosity & humility - natural

Leadership & Security Architecture

title: Senior Accounting Manager
description:
About Mozilla .org
Mozilla is a mission-driven portfolio of companies and organizations working together to shape an internet that serves people and the public good.
Currently, this portfolio includes: the Mozilla Foundation, which champions our mission through philanthropic risk capital; Mozilla Corporation, which makes Firefox; MZLA, which makes Thunderbird; Mozilla Ventures, which invests in responsible tech startups; Mozilla .ai, which creates open source AI developer tools; Mozilla Data Collective, a data sharing platform for human agency and fair value exchange. It also includes a handful of smaller strategic investments and Mozilla ’s investment reserve.
Mozilla .org serves as a steward of this portfolio, managing Mozilla 's assets and investments to ensure they are used to advance the vision outlined in the Mozilla Manifesto. In this role, it shapes long term strategy, allocates funding and manages Mozilla ’s brands. Ultimately, its job is to enable the success of all of Mozilla ’s organizations in the pursuit of the overall nonprofit mission. Over the coming years, our ambition is to actively grow the portfolio-helping existing organizations grow and mature while creating or investing in new organizations that can extend Mozilla ’s reach and build long-term financial value.
About the Role
The Senior Accounting Manager is a key member of the Finance team responsible for the integrity, accuracy, and scalability of accounting and financial operations across Mozilla .org and related subsidiaries. Reporting to the Head of Finance, this role owns multi-entity accounting, financial close and reporting, treasury, tax coordination, audit management, and financial controls. The managed entities include one non-profit organization and two for-profit organizations, one of which is international.
This is a hands-on role requiring strong non-profit and for-profit technical accounting expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to operate effectively across entities with different accounting, tax, regulatory, and reporting requirements. The Senior Accounting Manager will also help strengthen the systems, processes, and controls needed to support Mozilla .org as it grows.
Key Responsibilities
Accounting Operations, Close & Financial Reporting

• Own the daily accounting in the general ledger for the three managed entities, recording transactions in an accurate and timely manner, including journal entries, expenses, accruals, pre-paids, fixed assets, inter-company transactions, revenues, and other necessary entries.

• Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes across the entities, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting.

• Maintain the integrity of the general ledger and shared chart of accounts.

• Partner with the Head of Human Resources to ensure the accuracy of financial information in the payroll and benefits payment processes.

• Prepare financial statements, management reporting, and supporting schedules

• Own inter-company accounting and reconciliations, including shared expenses, management fees, loans, reimbursements, and elimination entries where applicable.

• Ensure appropriate accounting treatment across both for-profit and nonprofit entities, including grants, functional expenses, investments, fixed assets, allocations, and other transactions as applicable.

• Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting for Finance leadership and governance groups.

Treasury, Tax & Compliance

• Oversee cash management and treasury activities, including cash flow forecasting, banking relationships, account administration, and appropriate payment controls.

• Coordinate federal, state, and local tax compliance across entities in partnership with external tax advisors, including corporate income tax, Form 990, information returns, and other applicable filings.

• Maintain visibility into filing requirements, deadlines, registrations, and potential tax or compliance exposures across jurisdictions.
